items.title: ‘I have no financial safety net’: I’m 66, rely on Social Security and have just $500 in savings. What hope do I have?
items.description: “Sometimes I wonder whether wealthier Americans should trade places with people like me.”

items.title: Elon Musk opens the door for a big SpaceX acquisition
items.description: The rocket and satellite-internet company is looking to challenge telecom giants.

items.title: Data centers run on debt. That was a problem for bonds this year — and it’s only going to get worse.
items.description: AI debt issuance this year overwhelmed investor portfolios, and has disappointed from a performance perspective. The funding need won’t get any better with Democrats in control of Congress.

items.title: Nvidia, AMD and other chip stocks rebound — but is relief from the ‘violent’ selloff only temporary?
items.description: Analysts warn of further volatility ahead, although there are several new factors that work in the AI trade’s favor.

items.title: ‘It seems bizarre’: We’re in our 80s with $950,000 in traditional IRAs. Why is our adviser pushing Roth conversions?
items.description: “Our basic living expenses are covered by $110,000 in annual pensions and Social Security.”

items.title: ‘It feels like he’s quietly building a separate life’: My husband inherited $500,000, but he refuses to spend it on our home
items.description: “Our kitchen dates from 1999 and the oven only works if you hit the door a certain way.”

items.title: Micron’s stock is dirt cheap — and that’s igniting a fierce online debate
items.description: Valuation purists see a ridiculously inexpensive stock, but some semiconductor investors say Micron’s earnings power won’t hold up.

items.title: My 93-year-old father changed his will at the 11th hour, leaving my brother his entire $500,000 estate. Can I challenge it?
items.description: “My brother had no job and needed a place to live.”

items.title: Cybertruck’s run comes to an end as Musk kills off pricey pet project
items.description: The Cybertruck failed to catch on with car buyers due to high prices and some notable recalls.

items.title: My adviser recommended an annuity. Is it the right move in this market environment?
items.description: “I haven’t committed to the strategy yet and would appreciate some independent perspectives.”
